info.title: PyWinRT
info.description: Py/WinRT is a tool for generating a Python projection of any Windows Runtime library.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate Python projection for Windows Runtime types

options.name: --input
options.description: Windows metadata to include in projection

options.name: --reference
options.description: Windows metadata to reference from projection

options.name: --include
options.description: One or more prefixes to include in projection

options.name: --exclude
options.description: One or more prefixes to exclude from projection

options.name: --shapes
options.description: The ABI call shape census (shapes.json) that the tables name their members' call shapes out of. Defaults to the copy that ships beside this tool, which is the census the matching winrt-runtime was built from.

options.name: --emit-shapes
options.description: Directory holding the ABI call shape census (shapes.json) and the trampoline instantiations (shapes-generated.h) that this run merges into, which is how a census gains a shape. A projection generated this way needs a winrt-runtime built from the same directory. With --verbose, the merged census is reported.

options.name: --component-dlls
options.description: Set this flag when generating projection for user components that will ship with the required .dlls in the Python package

options.name: --dll-package
options.description: The Python module of the distribution that redistributes the component .dlls, when they ship in a package of their own rather than in this one

options.name: --legacy-method-aliases
options.description: Give each method that pywinrt v3.x projected under another name a deprecated alias with that name. Only a projection that pywinrt v3.x published has code that calls them.
